text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Bye bye! Take care of yourself, ma'am!
Whew, that's a relief. Time to
go back to
everyone—hm?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My pockets feel kinda light... Wait,
was it in this pocket?
Hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... Where'd that thingy I found on
the observation deck go?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'm not seeing it anywhere. Pretty
sure this is the right room,
too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Lift your gaze to the room containing
every number, for treasure
hides where the
beholder lies." I believe I've thoroughly
searched all
the high places in this room,
but could I have missed a spot?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We are on a time limit, so it might be
smart to double-check if we've
interpreted
the riddle correctly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... While you're doing that, is it okay if I
go look for Urara? She's
taking a while to
get back, so I'm a little worried...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll go with you. Maybe a walk
is just what I need to come
up with some
new ideas.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! It's not here either! Just where did I
drop it? I gotta find it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Thank goodness, we found you.
What're you doing here, Urara?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice! Well you see, on my way back from
the bathroom, I met a lost
old lady, so I
helped her find her room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But then I noticed that I dropped the
thingy we found on the
observation deck,
so I've been looking for it! Sorry, I'll find it
real
quick!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Without that thingy, we won't be able to
run together. And that's the
one thing I
don't want to happen.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I entered Tracen Academy so I
could run a bunch. I wanted
to run in lots
of races and have a ton of fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
How exciting a race is totally changes
depending on who you're
running with,
right? That's why I really want to run in the
Beauty
Dream Cup.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I just know that running with you all will be
a super new, super fun
experience. Can
you imagine if I finished first? I'd be so,
sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But to do that, I have to find that thingy
first! It's gotta be somewhere
I walked past
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll help you look for it! Because... I want
to run with you too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason I wanted to be a muse
was so I could make
everyone smile. And
that includes you, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let me join the search as well. No matter
how important that item may
be, it
wouldn't do for you to injure yourself due
to needless haste.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To avoid something like that, it's
important for active Umamusume to
always
maintain their best condition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is... There's no need to
do it on your own, Urara.
Why don't we
start by retracing the route you took with
the old lady?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, the person from the hotel said
the annex was connected to
the main
building by a specific passage, so we went
down to the first
floor—oh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, the old lady got tired
partway, so we took a break
in the garden!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You haven't looked there yet? If so, that
might just be where our item
is hiding.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's take a look, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yup!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Curren? Sorry, we ran into some trouble.
We're currently headed
towards the
hotel's central garden in search of a lost
item.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You might be able to see us from the
room. If I recall, the window was
facing the
central... garden...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Curren? I want to test something,
so could you open the
curtains and stand
by the window?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Lift your gaze to the room containing
every number, for treasure
hides where the
beholder lies. The legend begins on your
marks."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You know how the riddle says "Lift your
gaze to the room?" We
thought it wanted
us to look up inside the room...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But what if it meant treasure is hidden in a place where you can look up at the room?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There it is! Urara, I found it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, how?! There's one over here, too?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, the riddle didn't want us to look
up from inside the room,
but rather look
up at the room.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno really outdid herself this time! ♪ Oh,
I also heard why Urara
took her time
getting back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Seems like she dropped the item we got
from the first riddle and was
looking for it
by herself. Guess what Rice said to her
when she found
out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason I wanted to be a muse
was so I could make
everyone smile. And
that includes you, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let me join the search as well. No matter
how important that item may
be, it
wouldn't do for you to injure yourself due
to needless haste.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To avoid something like that, it's
important for active Umamusume to
always
maintain their best condition.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see... Rice treasures the smiles of those
around her, and Ikuno
treasures
self-maintenance to prolong her racing
career.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As for Urara, she treasures each and every
race, always running her
heart out for first
place...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone has an ideal they wish to realize.
Still, how does this relate
to their desire to
obtain Ms. Beauty's racewear?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(It remains a mystery... However, I feel
myself getting closer to the
answer!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go meet up with the others, Fine. Just
you wait—we'll solve the
final riddle in the
cutest way this world's ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. Let us take on the final
challenge in a way that
befits us!

text_block_list.name: Polite Staff
text_block_list.text:
You're here to challenge the final riddle,
correct? Ms. Beauty
informed me that you
would be coming.

text_block_list.name: Polite Staff
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first... please enter the room.
Whenever you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Bonjour, Beauty Anshinzawa here!
Congratulations on making it here,
my
brilliant gemstones! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is she... streaming her voice from
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"You will have ten minutes to solve the
final riddle. Now, show me a
dazzling
display of your beauty!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The right place, at the right time. Use the
photo as your hint to
acquire the chapel
key!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: At last, the final riddle is upon us!
